prompts.RIFT_MATTER:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one finished LORE TCG inner-card artwork, exact 1472x1344 landscape aspect 1.095:1, edge-to-edge illustration without card UI.
Primary request: Rift Ore - Starlight / リフト鉱石 - スターライト. A naturally occurring magical ORE in the Rift dimension, not a magical attack, a portal, an artifact display, or a finished jewel.
Reference image: the attached contact sheet shows 23 ACTUAL current LORE artworks. Study the whole sheet for consistent brushwork, broad angular painted shapes, clear silhouettes, structured stone, restrained effects. Specifically use the hand-painted rugged facets of the void-crystal artwork (top row fourth), the cool Rift environment and pale stone contrast of S13 (fourth row second), and the luminous blue mineral inside STARTER_MANA (third row second) as STYLE references only. Replace the old RIFT_MATTER idea (top row second); do not reproduce its scroll, indoor display or vortex.
Scene: a close three-quarter view of one strong irregular raw ore cluster emerging organically from a jagged charcoal stone outcrop in a quiet otherworldly Rift cavern. Rich dark violet rock strata, distant broken rock shelves and a muted pale mist create layered depth, no architecture. The mineral dominates central 65% with a bold readable silhouette: several broad intergrown crystalline blades, a substantial weathered dark rock matrix, unpolished chipped ends. Starlight is captured INSIDE the translucent icy silver-blue and blue-violet mineral as a few tiny warm-white star points and thin natural luminous mineral seams. The outside is solid painted stone with rough shadowed inclusions, some pale silver faces, cool blue inner planes. Illumination is restrained and material-bound, not overwhelming bloom or particles. Quiet, mysterious, precious natural mineral.
Style: premium hand-painted dark-fantasy game illustration matching the LORE sheet; confident visible brush shapes, controlled shading, strong broad values, painterly simplified silhouettes, crisp focal edges and atmospheric background. No photorealism, no glossy CG render, no anime. Secondary rock textures loosely painted, focal mineral detailed without excessive noise. Subject safe inside central 80%. No people, hands, faces, books, scrolls, machinery, shelves, podium, magic circles, floating cards, text, frame, border, logo, watermark. Deliver one single artwork.
prompts.RIFT_METALIGHT:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one finished LORE TCG inner-card artwork, exact 1472x1344 landscape aspect 1.095:1, edge-to-edge illustration without card UI.
Primary request: Rift Ore - Metalight / リフト鉱石 - メタライト. A naturally occurring magical METALLIC ORE in the Rift dimension. It is cost 2 unplayable magic; when another card sends it to Rift, its owner sends one card from the opponent graveyard to Rift. Depict natural mineral identity rather than literal card gameplay.
Reference image: the contact sheet contains 23 actual current LORE artworks. Match their painted facets, clear silhouette, readable material, broad light/shadow and atmospheric depth. Refer to the rugged rocks in void-crystal (top row fourth), dark-violet stone of VOID_RITE (second row second), painted worn metal of STARTER_TRASH (third row fourth), and environment texture of MANA_GIANT (fourth row first). These are STYLE references, do not copy their objects or architecture.
Scene: a different deposit of the same Rift dimension. Close three-quarter view, a single substantial rough metallic ore nodule embedded in a broken dark violet-black rock ledge, central 65% of image. Strong asymmetrical silhouette, broad interlocking stepped metallic plates and blunt fractured cubic mineral grains; clearly RAW mined mineral not armor, sword, ingot or jewel. Tarnished pewter, gunmetal and pale silver faces, with tiny iridescent plum and muted teal sheen along some fractured metallic edges. Dark crumbling stone matrix is visible between the dense metal plates, with a few narrow violet mineral veins inside. A subdued violet light reaches from deep in the fissure beneath the ore; grounded mass and painterly metallic glints. The distant Rift cavern is quiet, shadowed and atmospheric with suspended broken rock shelves disappearing into pale grey-violet mist, no constructed buildings. Distinguish this heavy opaque metallic mineral from a blue transparent star crystal. It belongs to the same world.
Style: premium hand-painted dark-fantasy PC game concept illustration, visibly painted angular brush shapes, simplified bold silhouette, controlled chiaroscuro, broad grouped values, selective rough texture, focal edges crisp and background loose, matches LORE sheet. No photorealism, no shiny CG product rendering, no anime. Subject safe within central 80%. No people, hands, faces, skulls, books, scrolls, machinery, podium, display case, magic circles, floating cards, exaggerated particles, text, frame, border, logo or watermark. Deliver one single artwork.

visualReview: Both generated outputs inspected inline; stone-bound raw minerals with differentiated transparent starlight and opaque metal silhouettes. No UI text, figures or library displays.
